decisions.reason: Including shared program costs in total capex does not change the independently specified operating-cost range or its source.
The shared-program capex decision does not change the eight-site count, site list, or site-level configuration basis.
Treating the digital platform as a separate capex line item does not alter its role as a revenue stream or any revenue assumptions.
The source changes total-capex composition but does not change the financing ratio, rate, tranche structure, or refinement trigger.
The source does not assign CCA classes or tax treatment to the newly enumerated shared program costs.
The capex presentation decision does not change the model currency or price base year.
Although total capex may affect calculated outputs, the source does not change the availability-payment sizing criteria or thresholds.
Resolving which shared costs belong in capex does not change the generic source-verification obligation or designated reference sources.
The existing requirement already applies generally to model assumptions; the capex decision does not change its documentation or traceability rules.
The source does not change the user-funded and PPP scenario definitions or the required availability-payment justification.
Adding separate capex line items does not change the required three-statement structure or financial-engine basis.
The source changes capex content and presentation, not the requirement that formulas and worksheet links operate correctly.
